text: Corendon Airlines is a subsidiary of the privately held Corendon Tourism Group; company founder/owner Atilay Uslu is confirmed by TravMagazine (2024). Co-founder Yildiray Karaer, the 2000 founding date, and the Dutch headquarters are not confirmed by this particular source.

source.name: TravMagazine, Corendon management
source.quote: Together with founder/owner Atilay Uslu, he has a non-statutory role in the five-member board of directors.
